manuscriptTitle: Cytokine response claims from a disputed assay batch

findings.title: Repeated measurement rows need raw-data verification
findings.action: Hold AI review output until source instruments, audit trail, and import logs explain the repeated rows.

findings.title: Collection timestamps are not machine-auditable
findings.action: Require normalized ISO-8601 collection timestamps before the assistant cites this dataset.

findings.title: Terminal digit distribution is unusually concentrated
findings.action: Ask for raw instrument exports or an explanation of rounding rules before trusting fine-grained effects.

findings.title: Measurement series is smoother than expected for independent observations
findings.action: Route to statistical reviewer for instrument drift, interpolation, or synthetic-row checks.

findings.title: Groups separate perfectly without overlap
findings.evidence: control: n=6, range=10-12.5; treated: n=8, range=20-23
findings.action: Require preregistered exclusion rules and raw row provenance before strong causal or classification claims are released.

assistantScope: Synthetic data-fabrication anomaly red flags before AI peer-review output is trusted.
